input-field.name: enabled
input-field.label: Send WhatsApp messages
input-field.helpText: The master switch. Turn it off and this plugin stops sending anything at all, without losing your key, your numbers or your wording. Orders carry on exactly as before.

input-field.name: apiKey
input-field.label: API key
input-field.helpText: Create one in the Njiwa console under API keys. A key beginning sk_test_ checks and stores every message and delivers nothing, which is what you want while you set this up. A key beginning sk_live_ sends to real phones and costs real money. The console shows a key once and keeps only its fingerprint, so a lost key is replaced rather than recovered. Shopware stores it in the same table as every other setting, which is not encrypted, so treat a database backup as something that contains this key.

input-field.name: baseUrl
input-field.label: Njiwa address
input-field.helpText: Leave this exactly as it is. It exists for shops that have been given their own Njiwa address, and changing it otherwise stops messages reaching anybody.

input-field.name: sendFrom
input-field.label: Send from
input-field.helpText: Which of your linked WhatsApp numbers these messages come from. Digits only, in full international form, such as 254712345678, with no leading zero: unlike a recipient, the sending number is never read against anybody's country. Leave it empty to use the number marked default in the console, which is the right answer if you have one number.

input-field.name: placedEnabled
input-field.label: Order placed, payment not in yet
input-field.helpText: Sent the moment the order is placed, before any payment has been confirmed. It is the one to use for bank transfer, invoice and cash on delivery, where the order is real long before the money is.

input-field.name: placedTemplate
input-field.label: Order placed, payment not in yet: wording
input-field.helpText: Anything in braces is filled in from the order: {first_name}, {last_name}, {customer_name}, {order_number}, {order_total}, {order_date}, {order_status}, {payment_method}, {items}, {item_count}, {shop_name}, {order_url}, {admin_url}. A placeholder that does not exist is removed before sending rather than posted to a customer. Clear this box and nothing is sent, whatever the switch above says.
input-field.defaultValue:
Hi {first_name}, we have your order {order_number} for {order_total}. We will let you know the moment your payment comes through.
{shop_name}

input-field.name: paidEnabled
input-field.label: Payment received
input-field.helpText: Sent when a payment on the order moves to paid. The one most shops want. A partly paid order is not this: telling somebody their payment came through when half of it did causes more work than it saves.

input-field.name: paidTemplate
input-field.label: Payment received: wording
input-field.helpText: Anything in braces is filled in from the order: {first_name}, {last_name}, {customer_name}, {order_number}, {order_total}, {order_date}, {order_status}, {payment_method}, {items}, {item_count}, {shop_name}, {order_url}, {admin_url}. A placeholder that does not exist is removed before sending rather than posted to a customer. Clear this box and nothing is sent, whatever the switch above says.

input-field.name: shippedEnabled
input-field.label: Order shipped
input-field.helpText: Sent when a delivery on the order moves to shipped, which is the moment the customer most wants to hear from you. A partly shipped order is not this.

input-field.name: shippedTemplate
input-field.label: Order shipped: wording
input-field.helpText: Anything in braces is filled in from the order: {first_name}, {last_name}, {customer_name}, {order_number}, {order_total}, {order_date}, {order_status}, {payment_method}, {items}, {item_count}, {shop_name}, {order_url}, {admin_url}. A placeholder that does not exist is removed before sending rather than posted to a customer. Clear this box and nothing is sent, whatever the switch above says.
input-field.defaultValue: Hi {first_name}, order {order_number} is on its way to you. Thank you for shopping with {shop_name}.

input-field.name: cancelledEnabled
input-field.label: Order cancelled
input-field.helpText: Sent when the order itself is cancelled, not when one of its payments or deliveries is. Worth sending: a cancellation nobody explained is what turns into a phone call.

input-field.name: cancelledTemplate
input-field.label: Order cancelled: wording
input-field.helpText: Anything in braces is filled in from the order: {first_name}, {last_name}, {customer_name}, {order_number}, {order_total}, {order_date}, {order_status}, {payment_method}, {items}, {item_count}, {shop_name}, {order_url}, {admin_url}. A placeholder that does not exist is removed before sending rather than posted to a customer. Clear this box and nothing is sent, whatever the switch above says.
input-field.defaultValue:
Hi {first_name}, order {order_number} has been cancelled. If that was not you, reply to this message and we will look into it.
{shop_name}

input-field.name: refundedEnabled
input-field.label: Order refunded
input-field.helpText: Sent when a payment on the order moves to refunded. Saying the money is on its way stops the "where is my refund" message before it is sent.

input-field.name: refundedTemplate
input-field.label: Order refunded: wording
input-field.helpText: Anything in braces is filled in from the order: {first_name}, {last_name}, {customer_name}, {order_number}, {order_total}, {order_date}, {order_status}, {payment_method}, {items}, {item_count}, {shop_name}, {order_url}, {admin_url}. A placeholder that does not exist is removed before sending rather than posted to a customer. Clear this box and nothing is sent, whatever the switch above says.
input-field.defaultValue:
Hi {first_name}, we have refunded {order_total} for order {order_number}. Banks take a few days to show it.
{shop_name}

input-field.name: alertEnabled
input-field.label: Tell me about new orders
input-field.helpText: Send a WhatsApp message to your own number when an order comes in. It goes once per order, the moment the order is placed, which in Shopware is the first moment an order is real: what exists before that is a cart, and a cart is somebody who reached the payment page and may never come back.

input-field.name: alertNumbers
input-field.label: Your WhatsApp numbers
input-field.helpText: Where that message goes. Digits only, in full international form, separated by commas if there are several. Everybody listed gets their own copy.

input-field.name: alertTemplate
input-field.label: Your wording
input-field.helpText: Anything in braces is filled in from the order: {first_name}, {last_name}, {customer_name}, {order_number}, {order_total}, {order_date}, {order_status}, {payment_method}, {items}, {item_count}, {shop_name}, {order_url}, {admin_url}. A placeholder that does not exist is removed before sending rather than posted to a customer. Clear this box and nothing is sent, whatever the switch above says. {admin_url} is worth having here: it opens the order in the administration straight from your phone.
